blocks.html: Where fabrication of structural members, and other regulated products is performed on the premises of a fabricator's shop, special inspection and progress inspection of the fabricated items shall be required by this section, the New York City Construction Codes, and Chapter 1 of Title 28 of the Administrative Code.
